intro.message: Sign in once. This phone stays signed in after that.
intro.context: Sign-in screen: line under the app name. The whole household shares one account.

account.context: Sign-in screen: label above the email field of the shared account.

password.context: Sign-in screen: label above the password field.

showPassword.context: Sign-in screen: button inside the password field that reveals the typed password. Keep it short.

hidePassword.context: Sign-in screen: the same button once the password is visible; hides it again. Keep it short.

signIn.context: Sign-in screen: the big submit button.

signingIn.context: Sign-in screen: the submit button while the sign-in is in progress.

wrongPassword.message: That email and password don't match. Try again.
wrongPassword.context: Sign-in screen: error under the password field when the email and password don't match an account.

offline.message: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
offline.context: Sign-in screen: error under the password field when there's no network.
